recommendations: Fix unused licenses: At least one of the license text files in 'LICENSES' is not referenced by any file, e.g. by an 'SPDX-License-Identifier' tag. Please make sure that you either tag the accordingly licensed files properly, or delete the unused license text if you are sure that no file or code snippet is licensed as such.

Fix missing copyright/licensing information: For one or more files, the tool cannot find copyright and/or licensing information. You typically do this by adding 'SPDX-FileCopyrightText' and 'SPDX-License-Identifier' tags to each file. The tutorial explains additional ways to do this: <https://reuse.software/tutorial/>
